chapter: 7-4 How to recover the MAIN PCB
route_summary: Service procedure uses an official DATANXmini.bin on a memory card, camera disassembly, designated discharge points and temporary solder bridging of specified MAIN PCB test points; bridge removed after recovery.
small_card_recommendation: less than 1GB; compatibility of current approximately 128GB card in this recovery mode is unverified
adjustment_data_preservation: claimed by manual; not confirmed on this camera
user_decision: retain recovery prerequisite; no experimental write
next_evidence_needed: recovery entry and firmware write coverage
suitable small memory card and qualified physical service setup
latest_user_instruction: download the service manual into the project folder and begin flashing
